python3 << 'EOF'
import json

# Data for matured noninterest-bearing debt (in millions)
data = {
    1960: 280,
    1961: 240,
    1962: 211,
    1963: 157,
    1964: 139,
    1965: 110,
    1966: 95,
    1967: 88
}

alpha = 0.4

# Single exponential smoothing
# Initialize S_1960 with the first actual value
years = sorted(data.keys())
values = [data[y] for y in years]

# S_1 = X_1 (first smoothed value equals first actual)
S = {}
S[years[0]] = values[0]

# Calculate smoothed values for each subsequent year
for i in range(1, len(years)):
    year = years[i]
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    S[year] = alpha * values[i] + (1 - alpha) * S[prev_year]
    print(f"S_{year} = {alpha} * {values[i]} + {1-alpha} * {S[prev_year]:.2f} = {S[year]:.4f}")

# The forecast for 1968 is the smoothed value at 1967
forecast_1968 = S[1967]
print(f"\nForecast for 1968 (smoothed amount outstanding): {forecast_1968:.2f} million dollars")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(forecast_1968, 2)}")
EOF
